actions.name: Pulse Laser
actions.desc: The baseline shot — first target in the forward arc. Fires, then reloads for a turn before it can fire again (a short cooldown), and each shot adds heat. Strong up close, falls off at range. The unit of comparison for every weapon.

actions.name: Beam Cannon
actions.desc: Sustained mid-range energy beam. Higher damage, moderate heat. The reliable main gun of a bow-on build.

actions.name: Particle Lance
actions.desc: Piercing spinal beam that strikes everything in the forward line at long range. High heat — an alpha weapon, not a sustained one.

actions.name: Scatter Laser
actions.desc: Wide spread hitting a cell and its neighbours. Devastating point-blank, useless at range — the close-band specialist.

actions.name: Point-Defense Laser
actions.desc: Rapid turret that can also shoot down incoming ordnance entities before they reach you. Low heat, defensive staple.

actions.name: Torpedo
actions.desc: Launches a slow projectile entity that advances one cell per turn toward its target. It does no damage on launch — the enemy must dodge it, shoot it down, or eat it. The core of the ranged positional game.

actions.name: Missile Salvo
actions.desc: Fires multiple fast projectile entities at the first target ahead. Many small impacts — an excellent chain and target-lock trigger.

actions.name: Heavy Torpedo
actions.desc: A slow, high-payload entity that detonates with a systems-offline pulse. Heavy heat; a capital-ship opener.

actions.name: Mine Layer
actions.desc: Drops a mine hazard on the cell ahead; it detonates when any ship enters. Persists and stacks — denies a lane segment.

actions.name: Broadside Battery
actions.desc: The signature weapon. Fires to BOTH lane ends at once — but only when the hull is in broadside stance. Trades your strong-bow defense for two-way firepower.

actions.name: Railgun Broadside
actions.desc: Long-range broadside battery. Strong at distance, can't bear up close. Best on a broadside ship holding the center against threats at both ends.

actions.name: Flak Battery
actions.desc: Broadside flak that splashes into adjacent cells on each side. Anti-swarm; pairs with the Flak Burst mod for chain potential.

actions.name: Tractor Beam
actions.desc: Pulls the first target ahead toward you. Picks an enemy out of a group, or drags one into your strong-bow arc and forward weapons.

actions.name: Repulsor
actions.desc: Shoves the first target as far back as possible; a ship that collides in the path takes collision damage. A ranged control tool, no base damage.

actions.name: Grav Snare
actions.desc: Swaps the target toward a held position and applies systems-offline briefly. Repositions a threat off your weak stern.

actions.name: Tractor Toss
actions.desc: Free-fire: swaps the contents of the cells directly fore and aft — repositions two other ships at once without moving yourself.

actions.name: Drift Mine
actions.desc: Places a mine hazard ahead that triggers on contact. A board feature, not an attack — strong against Pursuit and Burn-Hard ships.

actions.name: EMP Burst
actions.desc: Knocks out systems on a cell and its neighbours — systems-offline, skipping their next turn. Board control, sets up burst.

actions.name: Targeting Marker
actions.desc: Free-fire: target-locks the first ship ahead — its next incoming hit deals double damage. The standard capital-ship burst setup. Doubling applies after additive bonuses.

actions.name: Sensor Scramble
actions.desc: Spins the target's gyros — flips its orientation so its weapons point the wrong way for a turn. A defensive disruptor.

actions.name: Thrusters
actions.desc: THRUST one cell, or BURN forward to the first obstacle. The baseline maneuver — no heat, no cooldown.

actions.name: Afterburner
actions.desc: Free-fire BURN as far as possible without spending the turn. Pure repositioning that costs no tempo, a little heat.

actions.name: Blink Drive
actions.desc: Free-fire JUMP: short-range teleport ignoring the path. A reliable escape that costs no turn.

actions.name: Evasive Roll
actions.desc: Free-fire: reorient (toggle stance or flip) and shift one cell in one action. The fastest way to swing your shields to a new threat.

actions.name: Reverse Thrust
actions.desc: BURN backward (toward the stern) to open distance from a point-blank threat. A retreat tool.

actions.name: Brace
actions.desc: Raise a shield charge that absorbs the next hit. Directional — applies to the currently-threatened face.

actions.name: Vent
actions.desc: The WAIT analog. Dumps heat and recharges cooldowns by an extra step. The pressure-release valve — overheating forces it.

actions.name: Reroute Power
actions.desc: Recharges all weapon cooldowns at once and dumps moderate heat. Resets your whole battery mid-fight.

actions.name: Decoy Drone
actions.desc: Deploys a drone hazard that draws enemy fire and ordnance for a few turns. Buys a window to reorient or vent.

actions.name: Slip
actions.desc: Signature (Corvette "Slipstream"). Trade places with the ship directly ahead — slip past a blocker without spending the turn. Free-fire.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Signature (Ram "Ironprow"). Shove the ship ahead, dealing collision damage on impact. Pairs with bow-on stance + collision perks.

actions.name: Phase
actions.desc: Signature (Blockade Runner "Wraith"). Pass through the ship directly ahead — SLIP-style movement that ignores occupants and lands in the first free cell. Free-fire.

actions.name: Throw
actions.desc: Signature (Salvage Tug "Capstan"). Hurl the ship behind you, dealing collision damage on impact. The reversed-stance brawler's stern-arc tool.

actions.name: Swap Toss
actions.desc: Signature (Carrier "Broadside Bay"). Swap the cells directly fore and aft — multi-target reposition that reliably triggers chain subsystems.

mods.name: Flak Burst
mods.desc: On hit, if other ships are in adjacent cells, a burst deals 1 damage to each. The shockwave analog.

mods.name: Precision Core
mods.desc: If the hit exactly destroys the target, the weapon's cooldown recharges fully. Rewards clean kills.

mods.name: Incendiary
mods.desc: Applies hull-breach — 1 damage at end of turn for 3 turns. The poison analog.

mods.name: EMP Charge
mods.desc: Applies systems-offline for 3 turns, skipping the target's turns. The ice/freeze analog.

mods.name: Twin-Linked
mods.desc: Performs the attack twice. The double-strike analog — huge with high-damage single shots.

mods.name: Targeting Laser
mods.desc: Applies target-lock on hit — the next incoming hit on that ship is doubled. The curse analog.

mods.name: Autoloader
mods.desc: Loading this action does not advance the turn. The free-play analog — the only mod that can sit alongside another.

subsystems.name: Marksman
subsystems.desc: +1 damage when firing at long or extreme band. Always-on for back-line builds. (Sniper)

subsystems.name: Point-Blank Doctrine
subsystems.desc: +1 damage at point-blank or close band — voided if the action moved you that turn. (Close Combat)

subsystems.name: Rear Gunner
subsystems.desc: +1 damage when striking a ship through your stern arc. Rewards builds that fight reversed. (Back Stabber)

subsystems.name: Overcharge
subsystems.desc: +1 damage when the queue holds only one action. Non-stacking. (Monomancer)

subsystems.name: Crossfire
subsystems.desc: Enemies deal +1 damage when firing on each other — pairs with displacement that forces friendly fire. (Unfriendly Fire)

subsystems.name: Heat-Sink Rounds
subsystems.desc: A Vent action recharges one extra cooldown across weapons and the signature system. (Mindfulness)

subsystems.name: Center Mass
subsystems.desc: +1 damage when firing from the center cell of the lane. (Central Dominion)

subsystems.name: Chain Bounty
subsystems.desc: Chain-killed ships drop an extra credit — counts capital-ship chains too. (Combo Coin)

subsystems.name: Chain Recharge
subsystems.desc: A chain kill refunds that weapon's cooldown by 4 (8 at level 2). Lets a heavy gun fire far more often. (Combo Recharge)

subsystems.name: Chain Repair
subsystems.desc: Repair 1 hull on a triple chain kill. Counts as healing — triggers Overflow Capacitor. (Triple-Combo Heal)

subsystems.name: Chain Lock
subsystems.desc: A chain kill target-locks a random enemy — free burst setup. (Combo Curse)

subsystems.name: Cryo Chain
subsystems.desc: A chain kill applies systems-offline to a random enemy, in the same action — can pre-empt a hit. (Chilling Combo)

subsystems.name: Munitions Cache
subsystems.desc: A chain kill has a 1-in-5 chance to drop a Card field-kit item. (Combo Boon)

subsystems.name: Reinforced Hull
subsystems.desc: +2 max hull per level. Simple, reliable survivability. (Healthy)

subsystems.name: Ablative Plating
subsystems.desc: Begin each fight with a shield charge; -2 max hull. (Fortress)

subsystems.name: Reactive Armor
subsystems.desc: Taking damage auto-grants a shield — but not while you already hold one. (Reactive Shield)

subsystems.name: Shield Capacitor
subsystems.desc: Shield charges persist across fights, including shields bought in a bay. (Shield Retention)

subsystems.name: Damage Control
subsystems.desc: Reduce all incoming damage by 1 (never to 0); -3 max hull. (Iron Skin)

subsystems.name: Overflow Capacitor
subsystems.desc: Repair beyond max hull converts to a shield instead of wasting. Pairs with Chain Repair. (Overflow Guard)

subsystems.name: Coolant Bloom
subsystems.desc: When heat crosses the overheat line, freeze all enemies once — turns a crisis into control. (Chilling Blood)

subsystems.name: Inertial Dampers
subsystems.desc: -1 cooldown on the signature system (floored at 1). Non-stacking. (Quick Recovery)

subsystems.name: Strafing Run
subsystems.desc: +1 damage to shots if you moved with an action the same turn. (Dynamic Boost)

subsystems.name: Two-Vector Thrust
subsystems.desc: The signature system can fire in either direction. Non-stacking. (Two-Way Move)

subsystems.name: Gyro Master
subsystems.desc: Reorienting is a free action — but reorienting twice in a row target-locks you. Non-stacking. (Two-Faced Dancer)

subsystems.name: Cargo Expansion
subsystems.desc: +1 field-kit slot (max 6). Stocked by every bay. (Big Pockets)

subsystems.name: Black Market
subsystems.desc: Sell field-kit items anywhere, not just in bays, and for +1 credit each. (Rogue Retail)

subsystems.name: Phoenix Protocol
subsystems.desc: Revive with half your current max hull (rounded up) on a lethal hit. Once per life. (Fenghuangs Feather)

subsystems.name: Navigators Boon
subsystems.desc: The first reroll of every reward is free. A standing modifier on reroll pricing. (Seiryus Scale)

statuses.name: Hull Breach
statuses.effect: 1 damage at end of turn for 3 turns. Stacks duration, not amount.

statuses.name: Systems Offline
statuses.effect: Skips the ship's next turn(s). Capitals may be immune.

statuses.name: Target Lock
statuses.effect: Next incoming hit deals double damage; consumed on hit. Applied after additive bonuses.

statuses.name: Shields
statuses.effect: A directional charge that absorbs the next hit on the threatened face.

classes.name: Corvette "Slipstream"
classes.desc: The starting hull; a balanced beam + broadside opener with no strong stance bias.

classes.name: Ram "Ironprow"
classes.desc: Bow-on bruiser built around its strong front and collision damage; Chikara-style collision perks shine.

classes.name: Blockade Runner "Wraith"
classes.passive: When moving, the Blockade Runner advances as far as possible in the chosen direction.
classes.desc: The only class with a passive layered on the signature; a broadside skirmisher that refuses to be pinned.

classes.name: Salvage Tug "Capstan"
classes.desc: A reversed-stance brawler that fights over its stern, turning displacement into kills.

classes.name: Carrier "Broadside Bay"
classes.desc: Ordnance-heavy broadside hull; multi-target launches reliably trigger chain subsystems.

fieldkit.name: Coolant Flush
fieldkit.effect: Dump all heat and recharge all cooldowns.

fieldkit.name: Mass Lock
fieldkit.effect: Target-lock every enemy — next hit on each is doubled.

fieldkit.name: Sensor Pulse
fieldkit.effect: Flip the orientation of every enemy and capital.

fieldkit.name: Recon Die
fieldkit.effect: In combat: reroll enemy intentions. Out of combat: reroll a reward or bay.

patrols.mod: Lower chance for stim and field-kit drops.
Enemies have more hull (the Patrol-5+ value).
Corruption spreads — voidtouched enemies, all capitals corrupted, a new final boss.

commendations.name: Farsighted

commendations.name: Colossal Salvo
commendations.goal: Deal 25 damage in a single attack.

commendations.name: Puppeteer
commendations.goal: Have 40 enemies destroy each other across one run.

commendations.name: Cold Engine

commendations.name: Iron Helm
